HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   D. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   C. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.

9. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   D. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   B. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

13. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   D. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.

15. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

16. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain National Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
